basic_profile.bio: A budding DIY enthusiast based in the Pacific Northwest, who's recently taken up woodworking as a hobby. Loves collecting vintage tools and figuring out how they work. Enjoys spending weekends in the garage tinkering with old machinery. Not a fan of overly complex online discussions and prefers straightforward, practical advice. Works as a junior technician at a local hardware store. In a relationship with someone who shares an interest in upcycling and sustainability. Tends to browse Reddit mostly in the evenings after work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Has a growing knowledge of woodworking and tool restoration, which started from watching YouTube tutorials and participating in community workshops. Currently learning through hands-on experience and advice from online forums.
